That is the kind of America in which I believe, and it is with utmost gratitude and optimism that I stand before you today to celebrate the values that make our nation truly exceptional.

First and foremost, I am proud to say that I believe in an America where the freedom of speech and the courage of individuals to express themselves are protected and revered. This fundamental right is what has allowed our country to flourish, with diverse perspectives and opinions that shape our democracy and forge our identity as a nation.

I also believe in an America where the rule of law is upheld, and justice is delivered fairly and equitably for all. The rule of law is the cornerstone of our constitutional order, ensuring that our rights are protected and that our systems of government are accountable to the people they serve.
